qualification: For all posts, candidates should have qualified from an AICTE/UGC-approved college/institute or recognized university. || Where a university follows CGPA/DGPA/OGPA or letter grades, the candidate must submit proof of the percentage equivalent and awarded class, along with the degree certificate. || Candidates in their final semester, who will complete the course before appointment, may also apply; if selected, joining is contingent on passing with the required minimum score.
age_limit: The upper age limit is specified against each individual post (see the Pay & Age Grades table above for typical ranges). || SC/ST/OBC, physically challenged (PwBD), and Ex-Servicemen candidates are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India norms. || Government employees on a pay scale get a 5-year age relaxation, in addition to other applicable relaxations. || The cut-off date for age and experience is the last date of application submission for the respective centre. || SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/certificate, or any other valid document, is accepted as proof of date of birth. || The EWS certificate must strictly follow the DoPT-prescribed format (available at www.persmin.nic.in); the OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate must also be in the prescribed format.
